purpose: Define the common, season-neutral boundary between current-match choice candidate reports and explicit final-choice confirmation.

authority.major_season_migration: Declare or replace the major-season choice descriptor; common confirmation code and contracts remain unchanged.

source_boundary.s4_status: 4358 s=4 is an attention signal only. It does not prove the semantic panel type, candidate names, or final selected choice.
source_boundary.candidate_source: Obey each compiled descriptor candidate_input_policy. Current product active choices use current_match_user_report only.
source_boundary.final_selection_source: same-match explicit user confirmation or a separately declared proven final-selection source

confirmation_policy.confirmation_only_answer_owner: one explicit semantic follow-up or no strategy answer

owned_text_panel_recovery.stage_binding_rule: Only the fixed 2-1, 3-2, and 4-2 augment rows may be promoted; ignore non-augment rows.

active_season_choice_policy.confirmation_storage: descriptor-declared match variable or generic confirmed-choice history
active_season_choice_policy.post_confirmation_followup: Only a descriptor-declared, current-match, action-changing missing fact may request one user follow-up.
active_season_choice_policy.future_season_policy: A season without the prior mechanic does not inherit its mode, stage, vocabulary, storage field, or follow-up.

item_choice_policy.structured_inventory_context: trusted current item facts may inform advice but do not prove which visible choice candidate was selected

compatibility_fixture.reason: Season-neutral fold scenarios remain useful as regression evidence, but production confirmation is owned by canonical runtime state plus compiled active rules.
